claude-haiku-5-5@1.rationale: Default effort medium (documented default and recommended start); adaptive thinking stays on; 16000 max_tokens leave room for thinking plus the Phase-8 JSON.

claude-sonnet-5-5@1.rationale: Effort medium instead of default high bounds cost and latency for one structured extraction; fixed before results; thinking cannot be disabled on this model.

call_plan.primary: 6 cases x 2 models = 12 primary runs, each exactly once via `agent-arena audit run --live`
call_plan.order: all Haiku cases LS-01..LS-06, then all Sonnet cases LS-01..LS-06
call_plan.counterreview: only when the Phase9 route after the primary run is REVIEW_RECOMMENDED; at most one per case and model
call_plan.stability: only after a completed counterreview while the case stays mandatory and technically complete; Phase9 records a no-op reversal (single evidence item) without any call; at most one per case and model
call_plan.technical_retries: at most one per failed request for transport/server errors, at most four in total, each separately reserved

budget.reservation: conservative maximal exposure per call (UTF-8 byte input bound + max_tokens output incl. thinking), settled to confirmed usage cost; unknown billing stays bound

technical_criteria.slot_technical_pass: provider call completed (HTTP 200, stop_reason end_turn, final text present), raw response captured, ledger settled, parser accepted the JSON (parse_ok), bundle written and `audit inspect` valid with Markdown and HTML
technical_criteria.extraction_quality: reported separately: Phase8 technical_status completed vs incomplete
technical_criteria.LIVE_SMOKE_PASS: 12/12 primary slots technically pass, triggered Phase9 paths executed live and bound, ledger reconciled within budget; non-triggered Phase9 paths reported as not_exercised
technical_criteria.LIVE_SMOKE_PARTIAL: a primary slot fails technically, or a Phase9 path (counterreview/stability) was not exercised live
technical_criteria.LIVE_SMOKE_BLOCKED: external access, budget enforcement or an open material defect prevents the run

release_policy: Only clearly labelled test-only local releases for READY_FOR_RELEASE bundles; no human adjudication or signature is created; required human decisions stay open.
